{{hatnote|Historical official Players Committee website domain. For the modern official site see [https://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org].}}

'''swccgpc.com''' was the official website domain of the Star Wars CCG [[Players Committee]] (PC) until June 2009, when the PC moved to starwarsccg.org.

== Role ==

By '''6 November 2002''' the domain hosted ''The SWCCG Player's Committee'', the official website for the Star Wars Customizable Card Game.<ref name="swccgpc2002s">[https://web.archive.org/web/20021106101746/http://www.swccgpc.com/ The SWCCG Player's Committee], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 6 November 2002)</ref> That first capture still notes "placeholder pages in a few links".<ref name="swccgpc2002s" /> On '''6 February 2003''' the site moved to a frames format and added a Resources page, Advocate biographies and a Shadow Squadron volunteer locator.<ref name="pc-feb03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030423221707/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/february03archives.htm February 03 Updates], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 23 April 2003.</ref> The domain also hosted the 2001 RamapoCon 3 convention site (7–10 June 2001, Ramapo College, Mahwah, New Jersey).<ref name="pc-ramapo">[https://web.archive.org/web/20071217070344/http://www.swccgpc.com/ramapocon/index.html RamapoCon 3], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 17 December 2007.</ref>

From about 2006 the site ran on PHP-Nuke, with news topics such as Organized Play, PC Announcement and Writing Team.<ref name="pc-search06">[https://web.archive.org/web/20060617220203/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Search&topic=2 Search: Organized Play] (June 2006), swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 17 June 2006.</ref> Its download library carried the virtual sets, the Advanced Rulebook and the PC newsletter ''Obi-Wan's Journal'' (issue 1, October 2006; issue 2, January 2007).<ref name="pc-dl1">[https://web.archive.org/web/20071024151733/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads&d_op=viewdownload&cid=1 Downloads: Virtual Cards], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 24 October 2007.</ref><ref name="pc-dl7">[https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153258/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Downloads&d_op=viewdownload&cid=7 Downloads: Newsletter], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 24 October 2007.</ref> It also hosted an Online Rules Wiki built by Christoph Stieler of [sw-ip].<ref name="pc-sid61">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080617225415/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=61 Full Year 07 - Partner Site of the Year. [sw-ip]] (7 December 2007), swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 17 June 2008.</ref> In '''mid-2006''' the domain still hosted the official Advocates roster.<ref name="advocates2006s">[https://web.archive.org/web/20060617221233/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Content&pa=showpage&pid=3 Advocates], swccgpc.com (published 2006-05-01; Wayback 17 June 2006)</ref> By '''31 August 2008''' the site's PHP-Nuke '''Encyclopedia''' module was a player-resource hub (rules, virtual cards, tournaments, volunteers, tools, store, premium membership)&mdash;see [[swccgpc.com Encyclopedia]].<ref name="enc2008s">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080831140913/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Encyclopedia Encyclopedia], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 31 August 2008)</ref>

A new swccgpc.com, designed by Brandon Miller, went live on '''20 September 2008'''.<ref name="pc-news0809">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080925013637/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/news/ News (September 2008)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 25 September 2008.</ref> Its "Who We Are" page described the 480-card Cube and online play through GEngine, Holotable and swccgonline.com.<ref name="pc-about08">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080925100950/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/about/ Who We Are] (September 2008), swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 25 September 2008.</ref> On '''10 June 2009''', PC news announced completion of a move to a new server and forwarding to the new domain '''StarWarsCCG.org''' (starwarsccg.org).<ref name="domain2009s">[https://web.archive.org/web/20090706102740/http://www.starwarsccg.org/news/news.php?id=69 New Domain and Server], starwarsccg.org (posted 10 June 2009; Wayback 6 July 2009)</ref> News pages still served on swccgpc.com in 2010 gave their permalinks on www.starwarsccg.org.<ref name="pc-news87">[https://web.archive.org/web/20100506000733/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/news/news.php?id=87 Virtual Block 6.3: Mercenaries – Released!], posted by Rogue4 (12 March 2010), swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 6 May 2010.</ref>

By '''July 2019''' swccgpc.com hosted an unrelated third-party site, "SW:CCG DB (Beta)", a deckbuilder.<ref name="pc-2019about">[https://web.archive.org/web/20190721231010/http://swccgpc.com/about About (SW:CCG DB)] (July 2019), swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 21 July 2019.</ref>
